verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an on-prem container with a Helm chart for Kubernetes and a lightweight surya-us container, so customers can run its models on infrastructure they control. However, the official self-hosted product requires an Enterprise contract, and the free open-source path (Chandra, Marker, Surya) gets only a single passing mention. Missing for 10: self-hosting without an Enterprise contract, evidence that platform features like pipelines and form filling run on-prem, detailed docs on self-hosting the open-source components, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
